injuries.detail: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Nelson (ankle) is probable for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.
Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
